hero.lead: Protect a cracked, worn or weakened tooth with a crown made to match your smile. Porcelain and ceramic, designed in-house by Dr. Neda Moezzi.

intro.heading: What a dental crown does
paragraphs: A dental crown is a custom cap that covers a tooth weakened by decay, a crack, a large filling or a root canal. Where a filling patches part of a tooth, a crown restores its full shape, strength and appearance so it can chew and function normally again. At Valencia Smile Expert we craft crowns from durable porcelain and ceramic, matched to the color of your natural teeth.

Crowns are often the right choice when a tooth is too damaged for a filling but healthy enough to save. They strengthen teeth with large fillings or fractures, restore chewing and speech, improve the look of discolored or misshapen teeth and protect a tooth after root canal treatment. Dr. Moezzi makes custom crowns in-house, so same-day crowns are possible in some cases, and patients in Santa Clarita with an urgent problem can often be seen the same day.

whoItsFor.heading: Who it's for
whoItsFor.intro: We recommend a crown when a tooth is too weak for a filling alone, including:
items: Teeth treated with a root canal
Discolored or misshapen teeth with cosmetic concerns

benefits.heading: Benefits of a crown
benefits.intro: A crown protects the tooth underneath and keeps your smile looking even.

items.title: Strength and protection
items.text: A durable cover shields a weak or fractured tooth from breaking further.

items.title: Natural appearance
items.text: Porcelain and ceramic are color-matched to blend with the surrounding teeth.

items.title: Comfortable function
items.text: Restoring the full shape of the tooth lets you chew and speak normally, with less sensitivity.

items.title: Long-lasting
items.text: With good hygiene and routine visits, crowns can last 10 to 15 years or longer.

items.title: Keeps your own tooth
items.text: A crown preserves the natural tooth underneath rather than replacing it.

items.title: Avoids bigger treatment
items.text: Protecting a damaged tooth early can help you avoid extraction or more invasive work later.

process.heading: The crown procedure
process.intro: Three steps, with a temporary crown protecting the tooth in between unless a same-day crown is planned.

steps.title: Exam and preparation
steps.text: A full exam, then Dr. Moezzi reshapes the damaged tooth so it can hold a crown securely. A digital impression is taken for accuracy and comfort, with no trays.

steps.title: Temporary protection
steps.text: A temporary crown protects the tooth and keeps your smile working while your custom crown is made. In some cases the final crown can be made in-house the same day.

steps.title: Final placement
steps.text: Your permanent crown is bonded in place, adjusted so your bite feels natural and polished to blend with the surrounding teeth.

technology.heading: Technology behind a better-fitting crown
technology.intro: Digital impressions and in-house fabrication mean fewer visits and a closer fit.

items.title: iTero digital scanner
items.text: Captures a precise digital impression of the prepared tooth without trays or putty.

items.title: In-house custom crowns
items.text: Crowns are designed and made on site, so same-day crowns are possible for some cases.

items.title: Digital X-rays
items.text: Show the extent of decay or a fracture and check the root before a crown is planned.

items.title: Intraoral cameras
items.text: Document the damaged tooth and guide precise shade matching.

aftercare.heading: Caring for your crown
before: Keep up your daily brushing and flossing routine
Avoid chewing very hard foods if the tooth is already cracked or weakened
Tell us about any sensitivity or grinding habits so we can plan the right approach
after: Brush and floss as normal, paying attention to the gumline around the crown
Avoid sticky or hard foods for the first few days while you adjust
Keep regular checkups so we can monitor the crown and your overall oral health
If you grind at night, ask about a custom night guard to protect the crown and your other teeth

cost.heading: Cost and financing
cost.text: The cost of a crown depends on the material and on your insurance coverage. Crowns are a restorative treatment, and most major PPO plans, including Delta Dental, MetLife, Cigna, Aetna, United Concordia, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Principal and Humana, cover a portion. Our front desk checks your benefits in advance and you receive a written estimate before treatment begins. Flexible financing is available for any remaining balance. If you are new to Valencia Smile Expert, the $59 new patient special covers the exam and X-rays needed to plan your crown.

faqs.q: How long do dental crowns last?
faqs.a: With good oral hygiene and regular checkups, most crowns last 10 to 15 years, and some last longer. Grinding, chewing ice or hard objects and gum problems around the crown shorten its life; a night guard and routine cleanings help extend it.

Most patients find the procedure comfortable. Dr. Moezzi numbs the tooth with local anesthetic before any reshaping, and sedation options are available when appropriate for patients with dental anxiety. Some mild sensitivity in the days after is common and usually settles.

faqs.q: What are dental crowns made of?
faqs.a: Crowns can be made from porcelain, ceramic, metal or a combination. At Valencia Smile Expert we focus on porcelain and ceramic because they are strong, durable and blend naturally with your teeth, in keeping with our preference for biocompatible, metal-free materials.

faqs.q: How much do dental crowns cost in Santa Clarita?
faqs.a: Cost varies with the type of crown and your insurance coverage. We offer transparent pricing and flexible financing, and you receive a written estimate before treatment. Call (661) 254-5200 and our team will check your benefits and explain your payment options.

faqs.q: Can I get a same-day crown?
faqs.a: In some cases, yes. We make custom crowns in-house, so a same-day crown is possible when the tooth and the situation allow. If you have a dental emergency, we will do everything possible to see you the same day and provide temporary or permanent protection.

cta.heading: Protect the tooth before it breaks further
cta.text: Book a crown appointment in Valencia. Same-day and emergency visits are available, and you will know the cost before we begin.
